question.html:
Coherent monochromatic light is incident normally on a double-slit, in vacuum. The distance between the slits is m. A screen is located at a distance of cm from the slits.

A series of bright and dark fringes are observed on the screen. 

a. Explain how a dark fringe is formed.

   [3]

X is directly opposite the mid-point of the slits. P, Q, and R show the position of the first three dark fringes below X. The distance between X and R is mm.

b. Calculate the frequency of the incident light.
